title: Fix archive mutability and IPFS mechanics
description: Ch 9-13 (04-content-storage), 05-activity-types. 'Immutable epochs' is false: Entry.replies, deletion, edit, resignature rewrite epochs. NEEDS DECISION: move mutable state (replies, signingRecord, retention) to an overlay, or document rewrites. Decide typed IPLD links vs opaque strings (recursive pin/CAR export). Normative max object size vs 1 MiB block limit; media chunker/raw-leaves params; byteRange inclusive/exclusive; MediaManifest self-referential id; quality variants cannot share chunks; lookup for unfinalized chunk; remove false cross-user id-stability claim; contentHash duplicates CID digest (three names for retained hash); ATD reference by CID missing from examples; Note content ContentRef vs string.
design: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-18): Merkle tree/epochs never change. Entry holds only immutable fields (seq, ts, content id, original signing record). Edits = new signed timeline entry tagged replaces:<old id>; readers show latest. Deletes = new signed tombstone entry deletes:<old id> (assumed same pattern; content unpinned, CID remains in tree). Replies and resignatures live outside the tree in a separate reply index referenced from RootManifest.
